stages.command:
python3.12 - <<'PY'

import hashlib,json,pathlib,shutil,tarfile
r=pathlib.Path('/workspace/results/v8-dev-20261023T063431-ef8781f7')
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
archive=r/'source_panel_package.tar'
assert sha(archive)=='bab747035985d3a624251a620a0b17b3660d7ba3ac1fdd071802aaaa63f7b7f9','archive changed'
assert shutil.disk_usage(r).free>=118891450254,'insufficient volume space for package, weights and cache'
with tarfile.open(archive,'r:') as t:
 members=t.getmembers()
 assert all(m.isfile() and not pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).is_absolute() and '..' not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).parts for m in members),'unsafe archive'
 rows=json.load(t.extractfile('package_manifest.json'))['files'];expected={x['path']:x for x in rows}
 assert set(expected)|{'package_manifest.json'}=={m.name for m in members},'unexpected member'
 t.extractall(r,filter='data')
for x in rows:
 p=r/x['path'];assert p.stat().st_size==x['size_bytes'] and sha(p)==x['sha256'],'corrupt file: '+x['path']
print('PACKAGE_VERIFIED',flush=True)
archive.unlink()
PY
